name: pickProjectFolder
description: Open the native OS folder-picker dialog (modal to the Nexus browser window) so the user can choose a project folder for a code session. Resolves with { path, canceled }: `path` is the chosen absolute folder path, or null when the user cancels; `canceled` is true iff the dialog was dismissed without a selection. Test seam: when the NEXUS_E2E_PROJECT_FOLDER environment variable is set and non-empty, the handler resolves with that path WITHOUT showing a dialog (Playwright cannot drive a native OS dialog).

inputs.name: title
inputs.description: Optional dialog title. Falls back to the platform default when omitted or empty.
